hints.text: Check the dock's mode switch is set to TBT, not OCuLink.
The DEG2 waits for authorization. Enroll it once with policy auto so it is authorized on every plug-in.
The HDMI monitor needs a new session to appear. Offloading apps to the eGPU works now.
The driver is still loaded with no card. Log out before plugging the eGPU in again.
nvidia-smi is stuck in the kernel. Do not unplug; save your work and log out or reboot.

log_noise.why: Empty M.2 slot: its USB bridge logs SCSI errors. Harmless.

link.note: 2.5 GT/s x4 right after connect is normal for this enclosure.
